items.description: One folder of a repository that a module can claim.

path.description: The path from the root of the repository. It ends with a slash, for example "apps/server/". This is the form that `pathPrefixes` uses.

isProject.description: True if the folder holds a manifest of a package or an application, for example `package.json` or `go.mod`.

depth.description: 1 for a folder at the root. 2 for a folder in a root folder.

items.title: RepositoryFolder

400.description: No connected source of the workspace offers the repository now.

401.description: The request has no valid token or session.

404.description: The module has no such repository.
